basic_details.job_title: GMC Doda Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 29 Senior Resident and Tutor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (General Medicine), Senior Resident (T.B & Respiratory Disease), Senior Resident (Psychiatry) and 13 more
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College Doda (GMC Doda), Jammu and Kashmir, has invited applications for 29 posts in 16 roles under Advt No. 09-GMCD of 2026. The posts include Senior Resident (General Medicine), Senior Resident (T.B & Respiratory Disease), Senior Resident (Psychiatry), Senior Resident (Radio Therapy) and 12 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Deposit in the official account of Government Medical College, Doda: 0449010570000055, EX Branch, J&K Bank, Doda, IFSC Code JAKAOEXDODA; bank receipt to be attached with the form.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate qualification of MD / MS / DNB or higher qualification MCH / DM / DNB (super specialty), as per the eligible criteria of the post

how_to_apply: Download the application form attached with the advertisement notice or obtain it from the main Campus of Govt. Medical College, Doda Ghat during working hours.
Deposit the application fee of Rs-500/- in GMC Doda account 0449010570000055, EX Branch, J&K Bank, Doda, IFSC Code JAKAOEXDODA.
Fill the complete application form and attach self-attested copies of the listed documents with the bank fee receipt (pdf format).
Submit the form in the office of the Principal Govt. Medical College, Doda or by email to [email protected].
Submit within 10 days from the date of issuance of the advertisement notice.
Make sure it reaches by 3 December 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete forms in any manner shall be rejected without informing the candidates The number of posts advertised may increase or decrease at the time of selection

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Doda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Doda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: 3 Senior Resident (General Medicine), 2 Senior Resident (T.B & Respiratory Disease), 2 Senior Resident (Psychiatry), 2 Senior Resident (Radio Therapy), 2 Senior Resident (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation), 3 Senior Resident (Radio-diagnosis) and 10 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Doda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached with the advertisement notice (page 3), or from the main Campus of Govt. Medical College, Doda Ghat during working hours) and send it to Office of the Principal, Govt. Medical College, Doda, by by hand at the office of the principal or by email, to reach by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs-500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: PSC: as per LPC; Non-PSC: consolidated pay equal to basic pay of M.O/Assistant Surgeon of Health Department as per SRO-93 dated 15-04-2009 for Senior Resident (General Medicine), PSC: as per LPC; Non-PSC: consolidated pay equal to basic pay of M.O/Assistant Surgeon of Health Department as per SRO-93 dated 15-04-2009 for Senior Resident (T.B & Respiratory Disease), PSC: as per LPC; Non-PSC: consolidated pay equal to basic pay of M.O/Assistant Surgeon of Health Department as per SRO-93 dated 15-04-2009 for Senior Resident (Psychiatry), PSC: as per LPC; Non-PSC: consolidated pay equal to basic pay of M.O/Assistant Surgeon of Health Department as per SRO-93 dated 15-04-2009 for Senior Resident (Radio Therapy), PSC: as per LPC; Non-PSC: consolidated pay equal to basic pay of M.O/Assistant Surgeon of Health Department as per SRO-93 dated 15-04-2009 for Senior Resident (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate qualification of MD / MS / DNB or higher qualification MCH / DM / DNB (super specialty), as per the eligible criteria of the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
